# Code of conduct

These rules apply to everyone in this repository's issues, pull requests and discussions.

- Be kind and assume good faith.
- No harassment, insults or personal attacks.
- Never post someone else's private details.
- Stay on the topic.

Maintainers may edit or remove posts that break these rules, and may block an account that keeps breaking them.

To report a problem, email support@getmattered.com.
